display_name: Final check: Staff with a work phone
description: A short check for staff with a work phone at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional company, taken after the awareness episodes (pair BA). Ten new items from a Tarrowby work phone, the same kinds as before. It is matched to the first check (awareness_pre_mobile_ba), and the end screen compares the two results when the first check was finished.
organiser_note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
